lines.text: INterrogatio cuiuſdam Ducis, quem poſuit Rex Africæ,
lines.en: The question of a certain Duke, whom the King of Africa appointed,

lines.text: & erat ipſe, qui tunc præerat Africæ in contrarietate eo-
lines.en: and he was the one who then ruled Africa in opposition to

lines.text: rum eis rebellis, & dignus depoſitione. Interrogauitq́ue Dux
lines.en: them, rebellious against them, and worthy of deposition. And the Duke asked

lines.text: utrum præficeretur ei quod Rex præordinauerat de Duca-
lines.en: whether he would be put in charge of what the King had preordained concerning the Duke-

lines.text: tu Africæ, an nõ, & quid eſſet futurum de eſſe ſuo, & de eſſe
lines.en: dom of Africa, or not, and what would become of his being, and of the being

lines.text: illius, qui præerat ei, iuſſu Dei.
lines.en: of him who ruled it, by the command of God.

sections.en: CHAPTER XII. QUESTION CONCERNING the kingdom.

summary.headline: Question Concerning the Kingdom
summary.text: Chapter XII presents a judicial question about a Duke appointed by the King of Africa who rebelled against the king, asking whether he will receive the preordained dukedom of Africa and what will become of him and its current ruler by God’s command.
